subject: CareWell security & SSO evidence — post-demo action items
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Tom Ruiz <tom.ruiz@carewellpartners.com>, Sara Keller <sara.keller@carewellpartners.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Post-demo recap & evidence requests

Hi Tom / Sara —

Thanks again for the demo earlier today. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can keep the procurement/security track moving: 

- SOC 2: please confirm whether you need the full Type II report or a high-level SOC 2 summary. We can provide a SOC 2 summary (control matrix + scope) immediately and an access window for the full report under an NDA.
- Data residency & compliance: you mentioned US residency for PHI. Can you confirm which region (us-east or us-west) you require for storage and processing?
- SSO & provisioning: to scope engineering work we need: SP metadata (or IdP contact), whether you require SCIM provisioning, and whether RBAC needs per-tenant admin roles.
- Vendor questionnaire: if you have a vendor security questionnaire, send it over or we can fill out a short intake doc.

Proposed owners from our side: Rishi (security evidence), Monica (SSO/SCIM technical intake), Marissa (contracts + vendor questionnaire). Can you share your security contact for exchanging artifacts?

I've attached a short one-pager showing our SOC 2 coverage and a sample SSO checklist to illustrate what we typically provide.

Next steps: can you confirm the security contact and whether CareWell needs the Type II report vs. summary by EOD Monday (11/23)? If yes, we'll queue the NDA and send the summary.

Thanks —

Hannah Schmitt
Account Exec, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-security-onepager.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: sso-setup-checklist.csv (text/csv)

From: Tom Ruiz <tom.ruiz@carewellpartners.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Keller <sara.keller@carewellpartners.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap & evidence requests

Hannah —

Appreciate the recap. Quick answers from our side: 

- SOC 2: We will need the full Type II report for our procurement review, but a summary and control matrix is fine to start. The legal team typically asks for the full report later in the process; for now, send the summary and we'll confirm NDA logistics.
- Data residency: US-East (us-east-1) is our preference. We also need confirmation that PHI will be handled under a BAA (we'll coordinate on that).
- SSO/SCIM: We want SAML SSO + SCIM provisioning. I'll loop in our security team (security@carewellpartners.com) who will share IdP metadata and SCIM schema. Our provisioning model is org-level RBAC with a super-admin and scoped application admins.

I'll ask security to send IdP metadata and their standard questionnaire. Expect an email from them by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks — looking forward to the next steps.

Tom Ruiz
VP, Digital Operations
CareWell Partners
